meta.title: Hoi An Vietnam Travel Guide 2026 🇻🇳 Ancient Town Walking Tour, Hotels, Food & Tips (Daytime Edition)
meta.description:
Hoi An Vietnam Travel Guide 2026 🇻🇳 Ancient Town Walking Tour, Hotels, Food & Tips (Daytime Edition) brought to you by @TheFourChainsTravel 
Hoi An, Vietnam is one of the most beautiful and historic destinations in Southeast Asia, and in Part 1 of our two-part Hoi An series, The Four Chains Travel takes you on a complete daytime travel guide and walking tour through this UNESCO World Heritage city.

We'll show you the best way to get to Hoi An from Da Nang (or any city within 75 miles) If you're wondering whether Hoi An is worth visiting, this guide will help you plan the perfect trip while saving money.

During our three-day exploration, we walk through the famous Hoi An Ancient Town using the official Ancient Town Pass. We'll show you where to buy tickets, how the pass works, and the best attractions to use your tickets on. Along the way, you'll visit the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge, ancient merchant houses, historic temples, assembly halls, museums, and cultural sites that tell the story of Hoi An's role as one of Asia's most important trading ports.

We'll also attend a traditional music and dance performance at the Hoi An Traditional Art Performance House and explore the lantern-lined streets, riverside promenades, colorful shops, markets, and waterfront areas that make Hoi An one of Vietnam's most photographed destinations.
Looking for a great place to stay? We'll review a typical highly-rated hotel that costs less than $25 USD per night and includes breakfast, proving that comfortable travel in Vietnam doesn't have to be expensive.

Food lovers won't be disappointed either. We'll feature highly-rated restaurants across multiple budget levels, showcasing authentic Vietnamese cuisine and local specialties while helping you decide where to spend your dining budget.

In this video you'll learn:
✅ How to travel from Da Nang to Hoi An using Grab
✅ Why transportation costs in Vietnam surprise American travelers
✅ Where to stay in Hoi An for under $25 per night
✅ How the Hoi An Ancient Town Pass works
✅ Where to buy Ancient Town tickets
✅ The Japanese Covered Bridge and historic landmarks
✅ Traditional performances and cultural attractions
✅ The best streets, shops, and riverside areas to explore
✅ Great restaurants for every budget
✅ Essential tips for first-time visitors to Hoi An
This is Part 1 of our Hoi An travel guide series. Be sure to subscribe so you don't miss Part 2, where we experience Hoi An after dark, including the famous lantern festival, the Hoi An Memories Show and Theme Park, river boats, and the magical atmosphere that has made Hoi An one of Vietnam's most popular destinations.

If you found this guide helpful, please like, subscribe, and leave a comment with your favorite place in Hoi An!
